summary: The prepared source admitted DeepSeek-V4 non-EP TBO when attention TP was greater than one, although _forward_layers_tbo builds variable-length metadata and gathers input IDs over the full TP group. Added a narrow _can_run_tbo gate that falls back to the synchronous path for non-EP attention-TP>1 while retaining non-EP attention-TP1 and EP TBO.

tests.what_was_measured: The affected non-EP attn_tp_size=4, attn_dp_size=4 topology incorrectly returned True from DeepseekV4Model._can_run_tbo; the independent attention-TP1 and EP boundary cases passed. Raw output: reports/j-6c7e921f8b18/raw/pytest_tbo_gate_before.txt
All three TBO eligibility cases passed after the source fix. Raw output: reports/j-6c7e921f8b18/raw/pytest_tbo_gate_after.txt
Five DeepSeek-V4 unit tests passed, including the new gate regression and existing RoPE policy coverage. Raw output: reports/j-6c7e921f8b18/raw/pytest_deepseek_v4_units.txt

Executed FP32 matrix multiplication on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 and compared against an independently computed CPU result; maximum absolute error was 7.62939453e-06. Raw output: reports/j-6c7e921f8b18/raw/gpu_sanity.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: Single assigned AMD Instinct MI355X reported gcn_arch gfx950:sramecc+:xnack- and passed the CPU-referenced FP32 matrix multiplication check. This was a device sanity check, not the distributed DeepSeek-V4 reproduction.

remaining_limitations: The reported TP16/DP4 or TP16/DP2 workload requires two hosts and 16 GPUs; only one assigned gfx950 GPU was available.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro-NVFP4 weights were not available, so no full-model numerical A/B was performed.

The regression reproduces the incorrect actual _can_run_tbo strategy selection in the checked-out implementation and verifies fallback selection; it does not execute the full multi-rank collective corruption.
No native code was changed or rebuilt.
